Candidates in the CSV: body bbox centre (body_cx, body_cy; cabin+hull without mast), mask centroid of cabin+hull (centroid_x, centroid_y), full bbox incl. mast. A Blender boat's origin is most likely near the hull centre; use body_cx (x) and centroid_y or body_cy (y). All candidates move almost identically in x.
